newsitem.title: USA: Alumax denies in talks with Norsk Hydro.
newsitem.headline: Alumax denies in talks with Norsk Hydro.

text.p: Alumax Inc denied rumors that it is holding merger talks with Norway's Norsk Hydro A/S.
"Allen Born, chairman and chief executive officer, has confirmed there is no truth to the rumor" about the merger talks, an Alumax spokesman told Reuters.

An article in the March 10 issue of Business Week said Norcross, Ga.-based Alumax was holding talks with Norsk Hydro. The article, quoting an investment banker not involved in the alleged discussions, said the buy-out price for Alumax appeared to be about $55 per share.
The Alumax spokesman declined to comment about whether Alumax were holding any discussions about a major transaction. He cited traditional company policy.
Shares of Alumax traded as high as 39-1/2 before easing to 38-3/4, up 1-1/4 from Thursday.
Kaiser Aluminum Corp last year launched an unsolicited $2.5 billion bid for Alumax.
Alumax rejected the offer and Kaiser later withdrew its bid.
